exposure: time of cesarean delivery (daytime vs. night-time)
cohort: The study included 288 mothers who had a cesarean delivery and their healthy singleton neonates.
finding: Time to stage II lactogenesis was significantly longer in the night-time cesarean delivery group compared to the daytime group.
mod_finding: Night-time cesarean delivery is a risk factor for delayed onset of lactogenesis.
birth_weight: recorded but not a primary outcome
